spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (कजति)
To be disturbed or confused with joy, pride, or sorrow.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Watery, aquatic, produced in or by water.
n. (-जं)
A lotus.
E.
क water, and ज born.

m. (-लः)
1 A cloud.
n. (-लं)
Lampblack, considered as a collyrium, being applied upon the eyelashes or eyelids, medicinally or ornamentatively; also sulphuret of lead or antimony, when so used.
f. (-ली)
Sulphuret of mercury, Æthiop's mineral.
f. (-ला or -ली)
A kind of fish, (Cyprinus atratus,) or any kind peculiar to stagnant waters, whence the name.
E.
कत् for कुत् bad, and जल water or juice, as the moisture of the collyrium, &c.

n. (-लं)
Lampblack, especially considered as an application to the eyes: see the preceding.
E.
कत bad, and ज्वल flame.

m. (-जः)
A lamp.
E.
कज्ज्वल, and ध्वज a sign; also कज्जलध्वज.

mn. (-कः-कं)
The wooden stand or tripod on which the lamp is placed, a candlestick.
E.
कज्ज्वल and रुच to shine; affixes घञ् and कन्.
